parent_policy: C_star own S8 natural-history snapshots at anchor-1
teacher_donor: full current-frame pixel encoder + input_adapter + pinned RadialModule.forward_keyframe(adapted_features, fixed C_star rays_base); convert persistent BCHW rays to Bx(HW)x3 by permute(0,2,3,1) before flattening; native to_latents/process/depth_proj/confidence_proj; exact Decoder.forward_keyframe geometry transforms; commit geometry and four conditioned feature levels; retain original BCHW rays_base
source_note: Y12-D is a paired recovery-space diagnostic. It reuses the exact Y05-R C_star checkpoint and C_star own-history parent snapshots; it does not train or modify the base model.

hotfix.fix: Use pinned native RadialModule.forward_keyframe and exact native keyframe radius/confidence transforms; convert Y05 persistent BCHW rays to Bx(HW)x3 in channel-correct order before conditioning.
hotfix.reason: Y12-D 1.0.2 mixed keyframe-conditioned features with fast propagation readout geometry and passed BCHW persistent rays directly to a flat Bx(HW)x3 embedding, silently scrambling XYZ.

teacher_ray_layout.persistent_state_layout: BCHW (B,3,H,W), as returned by pinned exp1.keyframe_state
teacher_ray_layout.state_commit: Keep original BCHW rays_base unchanged in the persistent state tuple.

teacher_readout_contract.ray_policy: Use C_star parent's BCHW rays_base; permute to BHWC and flatten to Bx(HW)x3 for radial keyframe conditioning; preserve BCHW in state tuple.
teacher_readout_contract.scope_limit: Native radial keyframe readout under fixed rays; not full top-level Decoder.forward_keyframe camera re-estimation or complete keyframe reset.

purpose: Controlled state-component attribution on Y05-R C_star own S8 histories.
h0_policy: All four arms use exactly the same C_star current-frame prediction; only future committed state differs.

state_arms.E0_CSTAR: C_star radius, confidence, four persistent feature levels, rays
state_arms.E1_FEATURE_ONLY: C_star radius, confidence, rays; native same-ray Teacher four persistent feature levels
state_arms.E2_GEOMETRY_ONLY: native same-ray Teacher radius; C_star confidence, four persistent feature levels, rays
state_arms.E3_FULL_TEACHER: native same-ray Teacher radius and four persistent feature levels; C_star confidence and rays

future_protocol: H1-H4; no further writeback; identical RGB/flow; K32/S8
